data.title: Eden House
data.about:
Eden House Dubai Hills by H&H Development offers 32 luxurious 5 to 6-bedroom villas in the heart of Dubai Hills Estate. Designed by Hopkins Architects, these modern houses range from 6,188 to 7,822 sq. ft., sitting on spacious plots between 7,500 and 11,000 sq. ft. Eden House, Dubai Hills Estate is a branded development from the luxury developer behind iconic projects such as The Four Seasons Dubai and Baccarat Residences.

Known for crafting opulent living spaces, the developer brings the same level of sophistication to Eden House, creating an exquisite residential experience in one of Dubai’s most sought-after communities. Branded Eden House Villas Dubai Hills features unique designs with 5-bed villas featuring home offices and laundry rooms. Similarly, 6-bed villas boast rooftop terraces with stunning views.

For ultimate comfort, floor plans also include private gardens, elevators, and staff quarters. H&H Development Dubai Hills has crafted a perfect blend of elegance and modern living. With flexible payment plans, Eden House Dubai Hills is an excellent investment for those seeking a refined living in a serene environment.

characteristics_module.title: Eco-Conscious Luxury Living With Advanced Sustainability Features
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Situated in Dubai Hills Estate, Eden House offers easy access to Dubai's key areas, including Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and Dubai International Airport.
  • Spacious Luxury Villas: Featuring 5 and 6-bedroom villas with large floor plans, private pools, gardens, and panoramic rooftop terraces, providing comfort and elegance.
  • Exclusive Amenities: Residents enjoy premium facilities such as a spa, fitness center, swimming pools, and easy access to the vast Dubai Hills Park, perfect for relaxation and recreation.
  • Family-Friendly Environment: With top-tier schools and medical facilities nearby, Eden House is ideal for families seeking modern, convenient living.
  • Investment Potential: The luxurious, spacious villas are perfect for personal living and offer solid rental income opportunities in a high-demand area.
  • Flexible Payment Plans: H&H Development offers flexible payment options, making the purchase process smoother for investors and homeowners.

location_tile.title: Luxury and Connectivity at Eden House, Dubai Hills—Where Elegance Meets Convenience
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Eden House Villas are located in the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate, a master-planned community renowned for its lush greenery, championship golf course, and world-class amenities. Positioned next to Palm Hills, this prime location offers residents easy access to Dubai Hills Golf Club, Dubai Hills Mall, parks, schools, and healthcare facilities. With seamless connectivity to major roads, residents are just minutes away from Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and other key destinations, making it an ideal address for luxury living in the heart of the city.

5 minutes to Dubai Hills Mall
4 minutes to Dubai Hills Golf Club
12 minutes to the Mall of the Emirates
15 minutes to Downtown Dubai / Burj Khalifa
15 minutes to Dubai Marina
20 minutes to Dubai International Airport (DXB)
